rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when the admiring manner is clear from the action that follows.

example.english: They looked at the painting admiringly.
example.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 jan1 soeng2 gam2 mong6 zyu6 fuk1 waa2

rows.jyutping: jung6 jan1 soeng2 ge3 jyu5 hei3
rows.note: Use this specifically when someone speaks in an admiring or appreciative tone.

example.traditional: 佢用欣賞嘅語氣讚我份報告。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jung6 jan1 soeng2 ge3 jyu5 hei3 zaan3 ngo5 fan6 bou3 gou3
